name: zig-protobuf
notes: CPU-target variant: the very same zig-protobuf commit, generated code, harness and ReleaseFast build as zig/zig-protobuf, but compiled for the host CPU (zig's default target; no -Dcpu=baseline) so the compiler may use every instruction set the machine has (AVX2/BMI on x86-64). Every other implementation in the suite, including zig/zig-protobuf, is built for the generic x86-64 baseline, so this column is not like-for-like: it shows what zig-protobuf gains from host-specific code generation, not a comparison with the other libraries.

Allocator and everything else identical to zig/zig-protobuf: std.heap.smp_allocator, every message / buffer allocated and freed individually inside the timed iteration (the like-for-like rules are respected; only the CPU target differs).
The CPU model the binary was compiled for is reported in harness.runtime (builtin.cpu.model.name), so results from different hosts can be told apart.
Built by the shared zig/zig-protobuf build (one zig build produces all six executables); this directory only runs build/bin/bench-native.
